definitions.full: H1484. gor [ גּוֺר ] noun [masculine] whelp (as quarrelsome? or onomatopoeia? perhaps = Assyrian giru Zehnpf BAS i. 504 ) of lion; — אֲרָיוֺת גּוֺרֵי Jer 51:38 (|| כְּפִרִים ) simile of Babylonians; compare גֹּרֹתָיו Nahum 2:13 (|| id. Nahum 2:14) figurative of Assyrians.

occurrences.englishText: They will roar together like young lions.

“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
